checks.name: s2b_jtag_retry_r02_uart_stop_execution
checks.command:
"$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_jtag_retry_20261009_165853_r02'
$identityPath=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'uart_capture_identity.json'
$identity=Get-Content -LiteralPath $identityPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$captureProcess=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$identity.pid)
if ($null -eq $captureProcess -or [string]$captureProcess.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc() -cne $identity.creation_time_filetime_utc -or $captureProcess.ExecutablePath -cne $identity.executable_path -or $captureProcess.CommandLine -cne $identity.command_line) { throw '采集进程身份变化，拒绝操作' }
$stopPath=$identity.stop_flag
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stopPath) { throw '停止标志已存在，拒绝覆盖' }
$stopStream=[IO.File]::Open($stopPath,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::Read)
try { $stopBytes=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes('本次PS初始化及smoke已保存硬件结束门禁，关闭采集以核对完整原始串口协议。'+[Environment]::NewLine); $stopStream.Write($stopBytes,0,$stopBytes.Length); $stopStream.Flush() } finally { $stopStream.Dispose() }
$process=Get-Process -Id $identity.pid
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(10000)) { throw '采集进程没有在10秒内退出，保留日志待诊断' }
$raw=Get-Item -LiteralPath $identity.raw_path

[pscustomobject]@{status='CAPTURE_CLOSED_OBSERVED';pid=$identity.pid;stop_flag=$stopPath;raw_bytes=$raw.Length;raw_sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $raw.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();stdout=$stdout;observed_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');process_exit_code=$process.ExitCode} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"

checks.name: s2b_r02_uart_analysis_execution
checks.command:
"python -X utf8 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
r=Path.cwd()
src=r/'tmp/2B/S2B-T06/ps_runner_session_review_20261009_r02/review_receipt.json'
dst=r/'report/evidence/S2B-T06/ps_jtag_retry_20261009_165853_r02/ps_runner_review_receipt.json'
assert src.is_file() and dst.parent.is_dir() and not dst.exists()
b=src.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='e631660e7a1d66544a3bdc17c844ff940765f7d662b8627956241347c999b282'
with dst.open('xb') as f: f.write(b)
print(json.dumps({'receipt_copy':str(dst),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}))
p=r/'report/evidence/S2B-T06/ps_jtag_retry_20261009_165853_r02/analyze_uart.py'
assert p.is_file()
q=subprocess.run(['python','-X','utf8','-B',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'command':['python','-X','utf8','-B',str(p)],'code':q.returncode,'stdout':q.stdout,'stderr':q.stderr},ensure_ascii=False))
s=subprocess.run(['rg','-n','-i','warm|cache|冷|复位|重跑|初始化','vitis/s2b_ps_smoke.md'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
print(s.stdout)
f=r/'report/evidence/S2B-T06/ps_smoke_20261008_r01/build_08/init_boot.S'
assert f.is_file()
ls=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
print(json.dumps({'boot_S_sha':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'line_count':len(ls),'cache_matches':[{'line':i+1,'text':'\n'.join(ls[max(0,i-8):i+14])} for i,l in enumerate(ls) if 'cache' in l.lower()]},ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
